projects.title: On-Chip Offline Learning for Energy-Efficient Neuromorphic Accelerator
projects.description: Ongoing research project exploring local, on-chip learning for energy-efficient SNN acceleration using event-driven computation.
projects.longDescription: Ongoing research project focused on designing a neuromorphic accelerator that supports offline on-chip learning for spiking neural networks (SNNs). The work investigates learning rules compatible with hardware constraints (e.g., local spike-timing/activity traces) and explores architectural trade-offs in synaptic memory organization, sparse event processing, and update precision to improve energy efficiency.
features: On-chip synaptic update mechanism for offline adaptation

projects.title: Safe Plus - Smart Safety Helmet
projects.description: Advanced smart safety helmet integrating real-time monitoring, impact detection, and emergency alert systems for industrial workplaces.
projects.longDescription: Designed an advanced smart safety helmet with real-time monitoring, impact detection, and emergency alerts. Enhanced worker safety by enabling immediate hazard detection (toxic gas, impacts, falls) and automated supervisor connectivity via dashboard.
projects.myContribution: Handled complete hardware development, including sensor integration into the helmet, and wrote firmware for all real-time monitoring features.

projects.title: Denture Design Studio
projects.description: Interactive dental education platform for real-time denture design practice with self-evaluation capabilities.
projects.longDescription: Developed a graphical platform for real-time denture design practice for dental students, providing a safe learning environment with self-evaluation features.
projects.myContribution: Implemented student activity tracking, developed the Assessor page frontend, and built the backend logic using Node.js/Express.js.

projects.title: RV32IM Pipeline Implementation
projects.description: 5-stage RISC-V processor pipeline implementation in Verilog with comprehensive verification.
projects.longDescription: Implemented a RISC-V (RV32IM) processor pipeline in Verilog, including stages for instruction fetch, decode, execute, memory access, and write-back with hazard handling.
projects.myContribution: Implemented pipeline stages and developed testbench for verification.

projects.title: NeuroDrive - Vehicle Detection System
projects.description: End-to-end vehicle detection and classification system using YOLOv8 with web interface.
projects.longDescription: Built an end-to-end computer vision application for vehicle detection and classification across 8 vehicle classes, achieving 80.6% mAP@0.5.
projects.myContribution: Trained custom YOLOv8 model and implemented Streamlit UI with automated outputs.

projects.title: Real-Time Shadow Removal
projects.description: Image processing system for real-time shadow removal to enhance visual quality.
projects.longDescription: Developed an image processing system for real-time shadow removal to improve visual quality and enhance object detection in real-world applications.
projects.myContribution: Implemented shadow detection algorithms and image enhancement techniques.
